books.title: Cosmos
books.primary_focus: Bridges science and the humanities, exploring the 15-billion-year history of cosmic evolution and the human quest to understand the universe.

books.title: An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth
books.primary_focus: Shares lessons learned from training for and commanding space missions, emphasizing the value of negative thinking and preparedness.

books.title: Welcome to the Universe: An Astrophysical Tour
books.primary_focus: An accessible but mathematically grounded tour through the cosmos, breaking down everything from planets and stars to Einstein's theories of relativity and the Big Bang.
